title: FC 27 launches; Clubs moves into The Grounds
changes: Clubs is reached through the Clubhouse inside The Grounds.
13 archetypes, all unlocked from the start; Disruptor is new and Engine is gone.
Resets are free and single attributes can be changed.

source.title: EA, Pitch Notes: The Grounds deep dive
